fetchDetail.title: Fetch full detail per publication
fetchDetail.description: When enabled (default), fetches each publication's detail page for the full field set (organismo gestor, costo pliego, lugar de entrega, when present) plus attached document links. Disable for a faster, listing-only run.

maxItems.title: Max publications to extract
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of publications returned this run. The portal serves ~250 currently-open (vigentes) publications at a time, 5 per page.
